## Research topics

Peiman Jannatipour’s public work includes computational neuroscience, EEG, temporal cognition, human time reproduction, Bayesian and state-space modelling, neural time-series analysis, scientific reproducibility, neuroinformatics, research software, developmental neuroimaging, and neurotechnology.

  DOI: https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-9852649/v1

- A Bayesian Log-Time State-Space Clock for Human Time Reproduction
  DOI: https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6383218

- NeuroLab OS: A local-first software environment for scientist-reviewed neural time-series modelling and provenance-aware simulation
  Site: https://peimanjp.com/neurolab-os

## NeuroLab OS

NeuroLab OS is a local-first scientific software environment connecting neural time-series ingestion, preprocessing, explicit QC, scientist-visible model specifications, seeded fitting, simulation, in silico perturbation, and provenance-aware reporting.

The evaluated technical beta includes 11 computational model families and eight in silico model-space perturbation operations. Software verification should not be interpreted as biological or clinical validation.
